content: Heya bud - how do I make the different ghostly inks? I ran out of greater ones and have forgotten how to make them

Hey **RozRaid**! At level **106 Necromancy**, you have full access to craft every tier of ink, up to [Powerful ghostly ink](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_ghostly_ink). 

Crafting ghostly inks follows a **tier-upgrade chain**: each higher-tier ink requires the previous tier’s ink as a base component, along with higher-tier necroplasm and ashes. You can craft them directly in your inventory anywhere or at a [Necromancy workbench](https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy_workbench).

---

### 🧪 Ghostly Ink Recipes Breakdown

| Ink Name | Necro Level | Base Ink Needed | Necroplasm Required | Ashes Needed | Extra |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **[Lesser ghostly ink](https://runescape.wiki/w/Lesser_ghostly_ink)** | 20 | None | 10x [Lesser necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Lesser_necroplasm) | 1x [Ashes](https://runescape.wiki/w/Ashes) | 1x Vial of Water |
| **[Regular ghostly ink](https://runescape.wiki/w/Regular_ghostly_ink)** | 60 | 1x Lesser ghostly ink | 10x [Regular necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Regular_necroplasm) | 1x [Accursed ashes](https://runescape.wiki/w/Accursed_ashes) | — |
| **[Greater ghostly ink](https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_ghostly_ink)** | 80 | 1x Regular ghostly ink | 10x [Greater necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_necroplasm) | 1x [Infernal ashes](https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_ashes) | — |
| **[Powerful ghostly ink](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_ghostly_ink)** | 90 | 1x Greater ghostly ink | 10x [Powerful necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_necroplasm) | 1x [Searing ashes](https://runescape.wiki/w/Searing_ashes) | — |

---

### ⚔️ Action Plan to Restock Your Inks

* **Step 1: Stock up on Ashes**
  * **Ashes**: Regular imp/firemaking ashes.
  * **Accursed Ashes**: Dropped by higher-level demons (e.g., Greater Demons) or bought off the GE.
  * **Infernal Ashes**: Dropped by Abyssal Demons or Black Demons (great to buy in bulk on the GE).
  * **Searing Ashes**: Dropped by Lava Strykeawyrms (needed if upgrading all the way to Powerful).
* **Step 2: Gather/Perform Necroplasm Purification**
  * Since your goal is to **convert your Necroplasm to Powerful**, keep in mind you will need [Lesser](https://runescape.wiki/w/Lesser_necroplasm) and [Regular necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Regular_necroplasm) to build the base inks before you purify all your remaining necroplasm!
* **Step 3: Combine in Inventory**
  * Click on your necroplasm or ashes with the base inks in your inventory to open the crafting window and batch-craft them.

Need a quick recommendation on the most cost-effective way to farm or buy the ashes for your 120 Necromancy push? Let me know!
